newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends firmer, recovers early losses.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends firmer, recovers early losses.

text.p: A sharp hike in call rates helped the Bangladesh taka recover early losses and close firmer at 43.7450/7550 to the dollar in interbank trading ahead of the weekend, against a previous close at 43.7500/7550, dealers said.
The local currency opened weaker at 43.7500/7650 per dollar but recovered by midday amid deteriorating liquidity.

Call money rates closed at 20 percent to 24 percent against a previous 13-15 percent. Dealers said call rates rose sharply after payments against purchases of central bank bills worth more than 800 million taka. "Liquidity was already tight. Today's outflow further deteriorated the situation," said one dealer.
